answer: Entry slots are auctioned each epoch. Only 100 slots exist. Bids are sealed. Each bid locks for 3 epochs. A 2-epoch challenge window follows. Proven forgery burns the bid. Honest losers get a refund minus 2%. The clearing price is 60 units. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units. Double the demand and the price doubles. The walnut is hard to crack at scale. A garden of 1,000 clones needs 1,000 winning bids. An ocean of bidders pushes the price up. Honest agents pay one clearing price. Forgers pay the market they inflate.
